summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated tooling for the full model lifecycle—data prep, training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring—at scale. You need one when you're building custom or fine-tuned models, require reproducible pipelines, governance, and production serving across teams; by contrast, if you only need inference from an existing foundation model, a hosted model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is far simpler and cheaper. In 2026 the market has consolidated around hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and data-intelligence platforms (Databricks), with Databricks and SageMaker increasingly framed as broad data+AI environments rather than narrow ML tools.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker (SageMaker AI / Unified Studio)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/instance-hour for training, hosting, processing; no upfront fee. Savings plans available.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native enterprises needing deep CI/CD/CT pipeline depth and tight integration with AWS data, security, and application services.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute/node-hour for training and prediction; separate pricing for AutoML and generative AI (token-based) usage.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting real-time feature serving, strong AutoML, and access to Google's Gemini foundation models on GCP.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per compute instance; no surcharge for the ML service itself, pay for underlying VM/compute.
platforms.best_for: Microsoft/enterprise shops needing governance, responsible-AI tooling, and integration with Azure OpenAI and the broader Azure ecosystem.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based via DBUs (Databricks Units) on top of underlying cloud compute; commit/enterprise discounts.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting unified data intelligence—data, analytics, ML, and GenAI—with multi-cloud flexibility and MLflow-centered lifecycle.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions available within Databricks and other platforms.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open, portable experiment-tracking and model-registry standard that works across any ML stack.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage subscription for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking, visualization, and collaboration across any framework.

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; you pay for the underlying Kubernetes infrastructure.
platforms.best_for: Platform teams standardizing ML on Kubernetes who want portable, self-managed orchestration without vendor lock-in.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription / contract-based; consumption and platform licensing tiers.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and analysts wanting automated end-to-end ML with strong governance and minimal hand-coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core (H2O-3) free; enterprise products via subscription/license.
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting automated ML with strong open-source roots, explainability, and flexible deployment options.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.cloud: Serverless (runs on AWS/GCP/Oracle under the hood)
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second compute billing (GPU/CPU/memory); generous free credits for startups.
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting serverless, code-first GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models without managing clusters.

platforms.name: Metaflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed enterprise via Outerbounds subscription.
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting a human-friendly, Python-native framework to build and scale production ML workflows.

platforms.name: Flyte
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed service (Union) via subscription.
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams needing strongly-typed, reproducible, Kubernetes-native ML and data pipelines at scale.
